title: TrafficFacts
description: Other traffic reduced to facts about self's options, per sector around self: the answer of reduceTraffic and the `traffic` class of a Situation (ADR 0023). Not vessels: a Situation stays two-vessel, and these flatten to `traffic:<sector>:<key>` in the predicate namespace. Every field is pencil until the reduction is written. Structure only.

sector.$comment: count: vessels in the sector other than `other`. nearest_nm: range to the nearest of them. foreclosed: whether a helm action into this sector is foreclosed by that traffic.
